messages:
julian: Quick heads-up — planning a soft rollforward for the v2 header gate tonight 22:00 UTC. Goal: 5% canary -> 25% over 2h if stable. Need pinlist sanity, release-notes slice, and mobile SDK check.
deploy-bot: [sched] rollout v2-header-gate -> canary=5% start=2026-03-20T22:00:00Z steps=[5,10,25] pause=30m
maya: @julian can you confirm what counts as a pin? is it cookie/pref client-side header or server pinlist?
julian: Server pinlist. We respect client header `X-Redwood-API-Version: v2` but pinlist overrides. Added the tentative pins to the PR.
lee: Mobile SDK team: we'll need an opt-in flag for older clients. Current mobile min-sdk doesn't send the header when using old runtime. Could cause surprise 400s.
chris: Suggestion: add fallback route that rewrites unknown v2 payloads to v1 with `compat-mode` tag for 15m, then monitor error rate.
sre-ops: Telemetry thresholds: abort if 5xx rate > 0.5% above baseline for 10m OR p50 latency +200ms. Can we get a short eval script to run post-canary?
maya: I'll prepare a smoke script that validates schema and common prompts (size ~20). Post-canary it runs automatically via deploy bot.
deploy-bot: [hook] will trigger smoke-check: `smoke/v2-canary-check` after step=5% and on step=10%
julian: Release notes: add migration section + header example and mention mobile SDK sticky pin. I'll PR draft now.
lee: We'll pin all clients older than 2025-08-01 as fallback. Putting list in the pinlist PR.
chris: If we see client pins spike, can we auto-dump client telemetry + user agents to a private log? Ops ok with that?
sre-ops: Yes, gated to admins. We'll add short retention and alert on high client-pin churn.
maya: ack. I'll sync with docs and send release-note link here when ready.
julian: OK — plan stands. If no objections we'll start the soft rollforward per deploy-bot schedule. :thumbsup:
